crossRefs.note: God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.
For every matter of trespass, whether it is for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing…
“You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.
Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods?’

translations.web: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.
translations.bsb: I have said, ‘You are gods; you are all sons of the Most High.’
translations.kjv: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.
translations.asv: I said, Ye are gods, And all of you sons of the Most High.
